messages:
deploy-bot: Starting darklaunch rollout: feature/darkcache -> 10% on canary set canary-9876 (eu-west1). rollout_id=9876. :rocket:
alex: watching the rollout.
lucy: seeing a small uptick in 5xx from canary nodes, +3% vs baseline. cache hit-rate dropped ~12%.
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: canary-9876 error_rate > 4% (502/500 spike) -- paging @jamie
jamie: I'm oncall, looking now. what's the customer impact?
ben: support reporting intermittent failed sessions for customers behind CDN-A, some requests return 502s. small but noisy.
dave: logs show KV cache misses + model-variant mismatch errors. sample stack: ```
InferenceEngine::serve() -> RuntimeError: kv-cache key mismatch -> attempt to fetch weights returned 500
 at runtime/cache.cpp:214
```
lucy: that matches a recent runtime change that tweaked cache key prefix (hdr_v2 -> hdr_v3). darklaunch included that prefix change on canary. likely cache coherence issue.
jamie: is auto-rollback enabled for this rollout?
deploy-bot: auto-rollback: OFF for rollout_id=9876 (darklaunch mode). Manual rollback required.
jamie: action plan: 1) flip feature flag off (kill-switch) 2) drain canary traffic 3) flush KV caches on canary nodes 4) run smoke tests 5) verify metrics 15m stable -> close. assigning roles.
lucy: flipping flag now:
```
rdctl feature-flag set darkcache false --env prod --rollout-id 9876
```
lucy: flag toggle complete, targeting 10% -> 0%
deploy-bot: Feature flag toggled: darkcache=false. Traffic shift initiated (10% -> 0%).
dave: draining canary weight:
```
rdctl routing set-weight canary-9876 0 --env prod
```
dave: weight set to 0, drain in progress.
alex: running cache flush on canary pods:
```
kubectl exec -n inference canary-9876-0 -- /app/bin/flush-kv --prefix hdr_v3
```
alex: flush command returned OK, started background eviction across nodes.
alex: tailing logs -> errors dropping immediately. 502s down from 4.2% -> 0.6% in last 60s.
oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: ALERT CLEARED: error_rate returned to baseline for canary-9876.
jamie: running smoke test against a few endpoints:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}' | jq -r '.status'
```
jamie: smoke tests OK, latency normalized.
ben: customer impact summary: 24 customer orgs reported intermittent token-generation failures; no data exfiltration or PII exposure suspected. affected requests were retried by clients in many cases. preparing comms.
maria: draft support message ready, will post to affected customers in 10m after we let metrics settle.
jamie: holding incident until metrics stable for 15m. starting timeline in incident doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-9876 (draft).
lucy: root cause hypothesis: cache key prefix rename in runtime change combined with darklaunch created key mismatch across old/new runtime, causing backend to attempt incompatible cache loads -> 5xx. remediation: revert prefix change, add integration test for prefix compatibility, and add canary-only cache-warmup step in future rollouts.
jamie: owners: lucy -> root cause + PR, dave -> validation + monitoring, ben -> customer comms, alex -> cache flush automation. I'm on incident lead.
deploy-bot: Rollout 9876 marked as ROLLED_BACK manually. recorded by user lucy at 3953220120.
jamie: thanks all. please add notes to the incident doc and assign postmortem tasks. we'll keep this open until 15m stable then close. :thumbsup:
lucy: quick follow-up: adding a preflight check to the rollout pipeline to verify KV prefix compatibility and a safety gate to auto-disable darklaunch if cache-hit drops >10% during ramp.
ben: preparing customer impact spreadsheet and handing to CS.
maria: posting to affected customers in 8m with status + ETA for postmortem.
jamie: update: 15m stable achieved, metrics green. closing incident in 5. Thanks everyone for quick coord.
deploy-bot: incident INC-9876 closed (post-checks green)."
